lead: `python tools/dossier.py --record-perf` measures every feature whose figure is stale, and `--id <feature>` does not narrow it.
body: A run naming one new bench measured seven features and appended seven records to `docs/perf/members.ndjson`, six of them for members the slice never touched. Expect the extra rows and name them in the commit rather than reverting them — they are honest measurements from the same machine and the ledger is append-only.
